toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: bash
toolsAdded.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

toolsAdded.name: symbols
toolsAdded.description: Find JavaScript functions, class methods, classes and top-level bindings by name. Returns exact paths and line ranges, not source bodies. Query is a case-insensitive name substring; path is optional. Parser-based, no model calls.

toolsAdded.name: symbol_read
toolsAdded.description: Read one exact function/method/binding plus the file imports. Names come from symbols. Returns numbered source and explicit remaining-line count; use offset for additional pages. Reindexes after edits.

toolsAdded.name: symbol_references
toolsAdded.description: Find syntactic identifier references in production and test JavaScript. These are candidate references, not a fully resolved call graph; inspect the returned source before relying on a name match.

content.text: Resolve the upstream engineering issue below. Work in this checkout using the preprovisioned dependencies. The bash tool executes PowerShell 7 with no profile inside an isolated Windows filesystem; external networking is disabled. You may change production code, public tests and documentation. Preserve package metadata, dependency locks, configuration, native-verify.cjs, verification.json and .v4-* verification helpers. Do not install packages or attempt to access other workspaces. Run node native-verify.cjs for the repository-derived public smoke suite; you may run it with --tests-json PATH to test other existing public unit files. Independent grading reconstructs production changes in a pristine checkout and applies held-out upstream tests. Existing public snapshots may predate the requested behavior; do not undo that behavior merely to satisfy old snapshots. "as" TypeScript keyword yields error within Vue template **Prettier 2.5.1** [Playground link](https://prettier.io/playground/#-KQzyVQpyGDofwBSalcFl8seSH+gNGMDwB31huNSAALIXjmIfgBhCAYOMgF0AVlxOhyABVixsE8rNXAAJJQfiwC4VGAAQVHFwGuf7cHsQA) ```sh # Options: --parser vue --embedded-language-formatting auto --single-quote --tab-width 4 --print-width 120 ``` **Input:** ```vue ``` **Output:** ```vue SyntaxError: Unexpected token, expected "," (1:8) > 1 | (file as mymodule.Folder).deadline | ^ ``` **Expected behavior:** `prettier` should recognise TypeScript patterns such as the `as` keyword within Vue templates. I believe this issue has to do with the `--embedded-language-formatting` system not being able to parse the keyword, as when this option is set off the error is not given; however, setting this option off is not a suitable solution as it is quite useful.
